# Local chart dependencies

These browser scripts are stored locally so `../chart.html` can open without an internet connection. Keep this directory beside `chart.html` when copying the page.

Downloaded on 2026-09-13 from the page's original CDN URLs:

| File | Version | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tailwindcss.js` | 3.4.17 | https://cdn.tailwindcss.com |
| `lightweight-charts-4.1.1.standalone.production.js` | 4.1.1 | https://unpkg.com/lightweight-charts@4.1.1/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js |
| `papaparse-5.4.1.min.js` | 5.4.1 | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/PapaParse/5.4.1/papaparse.min.js |

The Tailwind URL is unversioned; the saved file freezes the version used by this page. The downloaded files retain their bundled license notices.
